newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs basket,nears 200-mark vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs basket,nears 200-mark vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket and brushed against the 200-mark versus the dollar before strengthening by the close, dealers said on Tuesday.
The forint finished at 199.67 to the dollar, compared to 199.70/75 at midday and 199.22/27 at the opening.

At one point in afternoon trade, the Hungarian unit crossed the 200-mark against a fluctuating dollar but there was no trade at that level and the unit moved back by the close after bottoming out at 199.92/97.
"There was an offer or two above 200 but no trades," said Peter Benda of Citibank.
"Trade was quiet except when the dollar/mark was jumping up and down," said Sylvia Kucsera of Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank. "That provoked some speculation."
As its dollar value fluctuated, the Hungarian currency remained strong, sticking to the central bank's resistance level throughout the day.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
